Protocol G - Gas (when only the gas is used)

Protocol cds protocol respiratory respiratory

Evidence: Grade B (traditional_use)

Summary

WARNING: Gas inhalation protocol. CDS must NOT be inhaled. This protocol is for external/transdermal use only. For respiratory conditions, use Protocol F (Immune Support) or consult a practitioner. Improper inhalation can cause severe lung damage.

Indications

  • Gas protocol
  • Inhalation caution

Steps

  1. Prepare CDS solution for respiratory support
  2. Follow respiratory dosing protocol
  3. Support with respiratory supportive herbs
  4. Monitor respiratory status
  5. Ensure adequate hydration

Dosage

Respiratory protocol: 1 ml CDS in 100ml water, hourly dosing

Expected Outcomes

  • Respiratory infection resolution
  • Reduced inflammation
  • Improved respiratory function
  • Systemic support

Monitoring

  • Monitor respiratory symptoms
  • Track breathing patterns
  • Watch for signs of infection persistence
  • Hydration maintenance

Frequency: Hourly dosing as needed
